corrected_control.scope: fresh-run reproduction of frozen V1 candidate metrics from the unchanged V1 checkpoint

general_numeric_basis: The frozen V1 head and exact sparse renderer execute float32 GEMMs and reductions. IEEE-754 float32 unit roundoff is approximately 1.19e-7; independent invocations can legitimately differ by several ulps because kernel reduction order and batch execution are not bitwise contractual. An absolute 1e-6 control is a conventional small multiple of float32 roundoff and is registered independently of any downstream candidate metric.
